#!/bin/sh
DESTDIR=/srv/legacy2/print-spool-recovery/printed
STATEDIR=/var/spool/cups/archive-state

if [ "$#" -eq 0 ]; then
    printf '%s\n' 'direct archive "Electronic Archive" "Raw payload archive"'
    exit 0
fi

if [ "$#" -lt 5 ]; then
    printf '%s\n' "archive backend: invalid argument count" >&2
    exit 1
fi

job_id=$1
title=$3
safe_name=$(printf '%s' "$title" | tr -c 'A-Za-z0-9._-' '_')
case "$safe_name" in
    ''|'.'|'..') safe_name="job-${job_id}.raw" ;;
esac

lock="$STATEDIR/.lock"
tries=0
while ! mkdir "$lock" 2>/dev/null; do
    tries=$((tries + 1))
    if [ "$tries" -ge 60 ]; then
        printf '%s\n' "archive backend: lock timeout" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    sleep 1
done
trap 'rmdir "$lock" 2>/dev/null' 0 1 2 15

receipt="$STATEDIR/job-${job_id}"
if [ -f "$receipt" ]; then
    prior=$(cat "$receipt")
    if [ -f "$DESTDIR/$prior" ]; then
        exit 0
    fi
fi

dest_name=$safe_name
if [ -e "$DESTDIR/$dest_name" ]; then
    dest_name="job-${job_id}-${safe_name}"
fi

tmp="$DESTDIR/.job-${job_id}.$$"
umask 002
if [ "$#" -ge 6 ] && [ -n "$6" ]; then
    cat "$6" > "$tmp" || { rm -f "$tmp"; exit 1; }
else
    cat > "$tmp" || { rm -f "$tmp"; exit 1; }
fi
chmod 0644 "$tmp" || { rm -f "$tmp"; exit 1; }
mv "$tmp" "$DESTDIR/$dest_name" || { rm -f "$tmp"; exit 1; }

receipt_tmp="$STATEDIR/.job-${job_id}.$$"
printf '%s\n' "$dest_name" > "$receipt_tmp" || exit 1
chmod 0644 "$receipt_tmp"
mv "$receipt_tmp" "$receipt" || exit 1
exit 0
ANTRIEB_ARCHIVE_EOF
